handoffs.name: grades
handoffs.do: Grade each run record that has no grade yet.

handoffs.name: monitor
handoffs.do: Read the run records and the code reviews not yet reviewed, and write findings.

handoffs.name: propose
handoffs.do: Write change proposals from the open findings, quantify each one's upsides and downsides, and order them. In a later round, revise them from the proposal reviews.

handoffs.name: review
handoffs.do: Review the proposals at the top of the order. Say in the step's reply whether further review can still materially change them: "loop": "again" or "done".

handoffs.name: developer-review
handoffs.do: Review the reviewed proposals, and give feedback and numerical corrections.

handoffs.name: decide
handoffs.do: Approve some proposals as change requests, and postpone or reject the others, each with its reason.

handoffs.name: code
handoffs.do: Write the approved change requests on a branch, in order. Commit each change, then run each of its command gates with S/src/gate-run.sh on the committed change; the program decides the gates from those records. Report each change in the step's reply.

handoffs.name: trial-runs
handoffs.do: Make trial runs of the candidate v+1, side by side with v when both can run, on the active use cases, with the run command. Grade each run.

handoffs.name: code-review
handoffs.do: Review the diff of each change the coder passed, and accept the code or request changes.

handoffs.name: release
handoffs.do: Choose between the version in use now and the new version with this step's changes, with the code reviews and the trial runs in hand: release v+1 or keep v.

handoffs.name: merge
handoffs.do: If the release decision released v+1, merge each passed change branch into the branch the step started on, keep each change's tag, and check that branch out. If it kept v, check out the branch the step started on and leave the change branches unmerged. Report the branch now checked out and its commit.

handoffs.name: pick-up
handoffs.do: Decide whether to pick up any remaining open finding, building on the version chosen at release. To pick up one or more, reply with "loop": "again" and "picked": the ids of those findings alone, and say nothing about the others. To pick up none, write one decision that accepts every remaining open finding as a known defect of the version chosen at release, which is then released to users, and reply with "loop": "done".

handoffs.name: use-case-grade
handoffs.do: Grade the run of the new use case.
